pattern.$description: Print textures. Grain is a MASK (colour from color.grain); halftone is a hard-stop dot pattern (not a gradient look). Both are disabled in print and under prefers-reduced-data.

grain.$description: Use as mask-image over a background of var(--color-grain) at var(--opacity-grain).

highlight.$description: Hard-stop highlighter band, slightly tilted; used by .highlight. Text stays var(--color-text)/on-highlight.
